decks.title: The Infrastructure Factory
decks.subtitle: An MCP front door, a policy gate, and where the agents work
decks.author: Max Körbächer
decks.description: A platform that turns requests from humans or agents into compliant, observable environments with clear cost attribution. The concept, then the architecture with an MCP server as the front door and agentgateway as the policy gate, how it connects to the software and AI factories, and where AI agents do their work inside it.

decks.title: The Infrastructure Factory
decks.subtitle: Software factories need infrastructure factories
decks.author: Max Körbächer
decks.description: The talk version of the concept. Coding agents made code cheap and the environments that code needs still wait for a ticket. The shift, the queue, the definition, the line, the twelve factors and where to start.
